accepted_interpretation.speculation_status: The proof establishes existence of the limit but does not by itself establish positivity or a simple closed form for the transition constant. High confidence in the removable-singularity mechanism; matrix dimensions and derivative indices should be checked against the display. Interpreting antisymmetry as hidden divisibility exposed by divided differences is reasonable. Matrix dimensions and derivative indices should still be checked against the display.
